Default pyramidal-tract parameter table

Source: R/pyramid.R
pyt_defaults.Rd

Returns the full D8 parameter table used by simulate_pyramidal_tract() when its arguments are NULL: the anatomical stations, the five somatotopic parcels (leg, trunk, arm, hand, face), their cross-section control points q_st (along u) and r_st (along v) at each station, the section widths width_u/width_v (mm), the twist map twist, per-parcel terminal stations (face ends at the pons, everything else at the cord), calibers (axonal radius, mm), the macro-axis macros, the decussation cross controls and the per-parcel FDA perturbation controls (reused by create_axons()).

Usage

pyt_defaults()

Value

A named list with elements tract_length, stations, parcels, q_st, r_st, width_u, width_v, twist, term_station, caliber, macros, cross, perturbation, as documented in DECISIONS D8.

Details

Coordinates follow the amended validation convention: at the cortex, positive u points toward the medial wall of the parcel's hemisphere and parcels are spaced by their relative sheet extents (leg -1.0, trunk -0.6, arm -0.15, hand +0.35, face +0.85).

Examples

d <- pyt_defaults()
d$parcels                       # five body-part parcels
#> [1] "leg"   "trunk" "arm"   "hand"  "face" 
d$term_station["face"]          # "pons"
#>   face 
#> "pons"
